words: say which of my projects are active, dormant or abandoned, going by how long since anything in each one changed. Where those lines fall is my own opinion, so do not fix a number of days in the code and do not make me pass one: have each age judged
descriptions: Say which projects in a folder are active, dormant or abandoned, going by how long since anything in each one last changed
Sort the project folders inside a directory into active, dormant and abandoned by the time since their last change; not for finding old files (fs.find) or for listing a folder (fs.list)
Show for each project (each subfolder of a directory) how many days since it was last touched and whether that makes it active, dormant or abandoned

params.name: path
params.hint: folder that holds the projects, one subfolder each; default the current one

params.name: only
params.hint: show only one kind: active, dormant or abandoned; leave out for all
